arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Bonner stated Lawrence sought relief in Florida state courts.
She noted the state courts denied his application.
Justice Breyer questioned whether the state judgment remains pending.
He suggested the application stays pending for at least ninety days.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests whether a pending state post-conviction application pauses the federal filing deadline. Lawrence claims the deadline stops while his state case is active. Florida claims the deadline continues running. The Court must decide which interpretation applies.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines when the federal filing clock stops. It affects every prisoner seeking state relief. It clarifies the interaction between state and federal deadlines. It determines the scope of equitable tolling under AEDPA.
